title: Downside of Allure beauty box
text: I had been receiving their beauty box for 2 years but had to stop because of financial reasons. I'm in a little better shape now so I thought after receiving their special offer Re- (subscribe now to receive this month’s box (with products from brands like Pixi, Erno Laszlo, and Sulwhasoo) and you’ll get a free Mally Evercolor Shadow Stick ($25 value) as a bonus gift. That’s $122 worth of products for just $15)  (which I didn't get). Needless to say I'l be cancelling my membership with them.
label: negative
